import os

from cyhole.solana_fm import SolanaFM

def main() -> None:
    api_key = os.environ["SOLANA_FM_API_KEY"]
    account_hash = "5eSF7DP2WsWk7Nk3fWnh98KtnKfnTsGuVJoY3rMHDKgB"  # replace with the target account

    solana_fm = SolanaFM(api_key=api_key)
    csv_data = solana_fm.client.get_account_transfers_csv_export(account_hash)

    output_path = "account_transfers_report.csv"
    with open(output_path, "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as report_file:
        report_file.write(csv_data)

    print(f"Saved transfers CSV export to {output_path}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
